topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Holography and Diffraction

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
lecture_lines: Light acts as an electromagnetic wave.
Waves possess both amplitude and phase.
Constructive interference adds peak to peak.

sections.title: Understanding Diffraction
lecture_lines: Diffraction is waves bending around obstacles.
Objects transform waves into spatial patterns.
Fourier transforms map these spatial frequencies.
animations: Show two beams [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/beam.svg] meeting at a point.

lecture_lines: Object beams reflect off the subject.
Interference freezes phase data on film.
